description_en: Deletes a RAM user or an STS account from a Hologres instance. Once deleted, the user can no longer log in to the instance. To restore access, call the CreateUser operation to add the user
description_zh: 将Ram子账号/STS账号从Hologres帐户体系删除，删除后，Ram/STS不能再登陆实例。如需登陆实例，请用CreateUser重新添加
kebab_example: aliyun hologram drop-user --instance-id hgprecn-cn-xxxxxxx --user-name p4_234253434 --super-user false --region cn-hangzhou
name: DropUser

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Hologres instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the Hologres instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The user name. Only RAM users and STS accounts are supported. Prefix the name with "p4\_" for a RAM user (for example, p4\_234253434) or "v4\_" for an STS account (for example, v4\_3234134).
parameters.description_zh: 用户名称，目前只支持 Ram 子账号和 STS 账号。如果是 Ram 子账号，以"p4_"作为前缀，如 p4_234253434；如果是 STS 账号，以"v4_"作为前缀，如 v4_3234134.
